thread:
morgan: Heads-up — Kodiak (private VPC) requested a change window next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need deploy owners, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. Can someone take lead? cc @tia @sam

tia: I can lead the deploy if @sam can cover rollback and post-deploy verification. I can be on-call 01:30-05:00 UTC.

sam: I can do rollback and DB snapshots. I'll prepare the rollback script and will be on standby same window.

ryan: Customer asked if we could shift to 03:00-05:00 UTC (evening PDT). Any strong reasons to keep 02:00-04:00?

morgan: Prefer 02:00-04:00 to avoid peak infra noise later in the day — also matches our Dedicated maintenance lane. If customer really needs 03:00-05:00 we can consider, but prefer 02:00-04:00.

tia: ok sticking with 02:00-04:00. I'll draft the runbook and canary plan.

deploy-bot: added provisional calendar entry for Kodiak change window (02:00-04:00 UTC). Reminder set 24h/1h before.

sam: Preflight checklist I'm expecting to complete before handoff: 
- DB snapshot + verify integrity
- Export infra config (terraform state + k8s manifests)
- Pin model version + upload artifact hash
- Backup KV cache state (where applicable)
- Ensure backups available in <region>-s3 for 30d

Quick commands I'll run in preflight:
```
# export k8s manifests
kubectl get deploy,k8s,svc -n kodiak -o yaml > /tmp/kodiak-manifests-$(date +%s).yaml
# snapshot DB (postgres)
pg_dump -h db.kodiak.internal -U deploy koda > /backups/kodiak-$(date +%F-%s).sql
```

tia: Canary plan: roll to 2 hosts (~10% traffic), monitor model health and tail logs for 15m, then ramp. Smoke tests after canary: `/health` == 200, token-throughput sanity, latency p50 < 200ms, KV cache hit rate > 60%.

ryan: I'll prepare rollback commands + a one-click revert in playbook: restore infra state + redeploy previous model image. I'll also add an alert policy in SRE: on error-rate increase > 3x baseline or p50 latency > 500ms for 5m => page.

morgan: Security question — any KMS rotation or secret push during deploy? We should avoid key rotations in same window.

sam: No KMS rotation. Using existing keys in vault. We'll not touch KMS.

tia: Post-deploy smoke steps (will run):
- run smoke script against canary pool
- run sample prompts through model check harness (sanity prompts + hallucination quick checks)
- verify billing token counters + cost anomaly check
- confirm metrics on console: token cost, per-route latency, error counts

morgan: Who's owning customer comms? I can send a heads-up email today and a 1h reminder. @ryan can you coordinate support escalation contact?

ryan: I'll coordinate with support and be primary escalation contact 01:30-05:00 UTC. I'll post the support phone + rotation in the calendar event.

deploy-bot: runbook link added to calendar event: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kodiak-vpc-change (editable by eng-platform).

sam: I'll attach rollback artifacts to the runbook and push the rollback script to the shared bucket before EOD.

tia: LGTMs from me. :thumbsup: I'll do the canary rollout and monitor dashboards.

morgan: Thanks all — I'll finalize the calendar invite, send the customer note, and drop the runbook link here once the invite is live. We'll treat this as standard maintenance (non-incident), no major service interruption expected.

ryan: Standby 01:30-05:00 UTC. Ping in thread if anything changes.

morgan: Great, closing planning here. Will post final confirmations + timeboxed checklist tomorrow morning.

(quick note: thread kept short — post any follow-ups inline; if we need to shift to 03:00-05:00 we'll reopen planning)
